notes.title: LTO Release Ready
notes.content:
[b]LTO Arcade[/b] release date is set and ready.  

It has been quite an interesting month - from downloading my first game engine to setting up a steam page for release I'd say 2021 has definitely opened a new door, unveiling an awesome future.  After hours of tutorials and countless trials during the vigorous learning curve; LTO Arcade has certainly become an impressive first installment.   

Thankfully the hard part is over and the game is officially ready for release.  Although I've given myself 3 weeks to continue fine tuning the mechanics and adding a bit of fun spice to the game; as it is right now I am happy.  This game pack will surely keep you occupied for hours and at its current price of $4.99 it seems totally worth it.

I've already begun a couple new concepts, including Pirate ship mechanics and getting used to how Inventories / trading can be implemented.  I've also started tampering with a few ideas for in depth skill trees for characters and how Traits/Skills can influence actions and dialogue.  

I look forward to sharing all future projects with you and can't wait to see what the future brings.

 -Bickley
LTO Studios
